name: Keycloak DevDay 2027
description: community conference on Keycloak identity and access management, plus hackathon day
details:
The largest Keycloak community conference, organized by volunteers, returns to Darmstadt for its fourth edition. Thursday 8 April is the conference day with talks and deep dives from the community and Keycloak contributors, followed by an evening event with dinner.

Friday 9 April is an informal community day with a hackathon and an OpenSpace in several breakout sessions. One ticket covers both days and the evening event; seats are strictly limited (the 2026 edition was nearly sold out early). The CFP closed on 24 Oct 2026.
note: English; 31 tickets left on 1 Nov; ticket incl. evening dinner
